name: @zumer/snapdom
description: High-performance DOM engine: captures a rendered element in the browser and exports it as PNG, SVG or canvas. Plugins add PDF, HTML, vector, GIF, video and agent context.

scripts.check: npm run lint && tsc --noEmit && node --test scripts/release-checks.node.mjs scripts/benchmark-statistics.node.mjs && npm run compile && node scripts/verify-legacy-bundle.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && REQUIRE_VISUAL=1 node scripts/vitest.mjs run --browser.headless --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:firefox: npm run check && REQUIRE_VISUAL=1 BROWSER=firefox node scripts/vitest.mjs run --browser.headless --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:webkit: npm run check && REQUIRE_VISUAL=1 BROWSER=webkit node scripts/vitest.mjs run --browser.headless --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:full: npm run check && for b in chromium firefox webkit; do REQUIRE_VISUAL=1 BROWSER=$b node scripts/vitest.mjs run --browser.headless --reporter=dot || exit 1; done
scripts.test:pdf: node packages/pdf/test/verify.mjs && node packages/pdf/test/megacheck.mjs && node packages/pdf/test/encryptcheck.mjs
scripts.test:vector: node packages/vector/test/verify-vector.mjs && node packages/vector/test/verify-h2d.mjs && node packages/vector/test/verify-plugin.mjs && node packages/vector/test/verify-mathml.mjs
scripts.release: git add CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m "Bumped version" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:plugins: git add packages/plugins/package.json packages/plugins/CHANGELOG.md package-lock.json && git commit -m "Bumped plugins version" && git push
scripts.release:pdf: git add packages/pdf/package.json packages/pdf/CHANGELOG.md package-lock.json && git commit -m "Bumped pdf version" && git push
scripts.publish:pdf: npm run test:pdf && npm publish --workspace=@zumer/snapdom-pdf --access public
scripts.release:vector: git add packages/vector/package.json packages/vector/CHANGELOG.md package-lock.json && git commit -m "Bumped vector version" && git push
scripts.publish:vector: npm run test:vector && npm publish --workspace=@zumer/snapdom-vector --access public
scripts.release:stream: git add packages/stream/package.json packages/stream/CHANGELOG.md package-lock.json && git commit -m "Bumped stream version" && git push
scripts.publish:stream: npx vitest run __tests__/plugin.stream --browser.headless && npm publish --workspace=@zumer/snapdom-stream --access public

author: Juan Martin Muda
